title: Red Pepper Tahini Dressing

content:
2 red bell peppers, roughly chopped

1 cup raw sesame tahini

1 cup water

1-2 cloves garlic

1 T Frontier Pizza Seasoning

1 T fresh lemon juice

2-3 drops liquid Stevia extract

Braggs, Dulse or Kelp granules to taste

Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend well and season to taste/add more water to adjust consistency.
